title: phyteuma orbiculare subsp. ellipticum
intro: Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. ellipticum, commonly known as Round-leaved Rampion, is a plant species within the family Campanulaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. ellipticum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and promote wound healing, which is primarily due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
